# Sweep

> Sweep is a free trading journal built for futures and prop firm traders. It tracks every evaluation, funded and live account, payouts and expenses in one place, with prop firm rules preloaded and verified every week. Available in English, French and Spanish.

Sweep is made by Sweep Inc. (Laval, Québec, Canada). Plans: Free (forever), Pro ($19/month or $159/year), Elite ($39/month or $329/year); every new account gets 60 days of Pro. Free keeps 2 prop accounts, stats on the last 30 days and 3 AI messages and 3 screenshots a day; Pro adds unlimited accounts, My money (payouts, expenses, real net), the full history and 50 AI messages a day; Elite adds an AI review on every trade, a weekly AI report and full economic calendar notes. Every plan includes a coach on every trade (no AI) and “Your edge”, the conditions where the trader wins, found in their own last 8 weeks. Trades sync automatically from NinjaTrader 8 and Quantower with Sweep's free add-ons (every account, whatever its connection: Rithmic, Tradovate and others); from other platforms, add trades from a screenshot (a history screenshot adds all its trades), in your own words, or by importing the platform's export (Tradovate, Rithmic, TopstepX/ProjectX, TradingView). Automatic sync for Rithmic and Tradovate is planned for later. Sweep does not offer trade replay or backtesting. Prop firms with preloaded rules: {PRESET_FIRMS}; any other firm{OTHER_FIRMS} can be added with its rules entered by hand; when a firm changes a rule, affected traders are notified and choose whether to apply it.

## Product
- [Home](https://makeitsweep.com/): overview of Sweep
- [Pricing](https://makeitsweep.com/pricing): Free, Pro and Elite plans
- [Free trading journal](https://makeitsweep.com/free-trading-journal): what the Free plan includes, forever, and what Pro adds
- [Prop firm tracker](https://makeitsweep.com/prop-firm-tracker): every evaluation, funded and live account with its firm's rules, for prop traders
- [NinjaTrader 8 sync](https://makeitsweep.com/ninjatrader): Sweep's free add-on sends every NinjaTrader 8 execution to the journal, read only, on every plan
- [How to start prop firm trading](https://makeitsweep.com/how-to-start-prop-firm-trading): a free 90-day gameplan for new futures prop traders, in three months with a gate each: guardrails and one learning setup on MES or MNQ, then tagging and one data-backed change, then an evaluation plan, a size ladder and a written trading plan
- [Gameplan, Month 1](https://makeitsweep.com/prop-firm-gameplan-month-1): 8 guardrails, the Sweep Setup (previous day's high or low swept, then reclaimed), a session routine and 30 daily missions
- [Gameplan, Month 2](https://makeitsweep.com/prop-firm-gameplan-month-2): tag every trade, find patterns with at least 10 examples, one refinement locked for two weeks, the firm's real limits tracked
- [Gameplan, Month 3](https://makeitsweep.com/prop-firm-gameplan-month-3): an evaluation plan in R, a size ladder from 1 to 3 micros, a funded playbook and a one-page trading plan
- [How to pass a prop firm evaluation](https://makeitsweep.com/pass-prop-firm-evaluation): target in R, daily stop, daily cap from the consistency rule, bad days the max loss absorbs, for every firm's 50K evaluation
- [When to size up on a prop firm account](https://makeitsweep.com/prop-firm-position-sizing): a size ladder from 1 to 3 micros, the drawdown test before each step, when to size down
- [Funded account playbook](https://makeitsweep.com/funded-account-playbook): five rules after passing, a payout rule written in advance, funded profit is not income until paid
- [Liquidity sweep setup](https://makeitsweep.com/liquidity-sweep-setup): the previous day's high or low swept, then reclaimed by a 5-minute candle; a learning setup, not a proven edge
- [MES or MNQ](https://makeitsweep.com/mes-vs-mnq): tick and point values, the same dollar risk in points, choosing one micro future
- [Quantower sync](https://makeitsweep.com/quantower): Sweep's free add-on, a Sweep Sync panel, sends every Quantower execution to the journal, read only, on every plan
- [Export trades from Tradovate](https://makeitsweep.com/import-tradovate): the Performance report as a CSV, then into Sweep (time zone, fees, session day)
- [Export trades from TopstepX](https://makeitsweep.com/import-topstepx): the Trades tab export as a CSV, UTC times converted, Topstep's trading day kept
- [Export trades from Rithmic R | Trader Pro](https://makeitsweep.com/import-rithmic): Completed Orders as a CSV, fills paired into trades, several accounts in one file
- [Payout tracker](https://makeitsweep.com/payout-tracker): payouts from request to paid, expenses and real net (Pro and Elite)
- [Features](https://makeitsweep.com/features): logging, real P&L, rules, the coach and your edge, review, analytics, accounts, payouts
- [How it works](https://makeitsweep.com/how-it-works): the daily loop and discipline
- [Sweep AI](https://makeitsweep.com/ai)
- [Economic calendar](https://makeitsweep.com/economic-calendar)
